title: Characterizing a specified halting output
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output, and let $x,w,o$ be Boolean words. The halting-run result on input $x$ under choices $w$ equals the output word $o$ if and only if the machine is in its halting state after those choices and its output word is $o$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output
